summary_bullets: Make Gate B passive-summary mode a non-blocking print-and-auto-continue path instead of a two-option AskUserQuestion
Reword passive-summary routing labels from Continue to auto-continue for consistency with the removed prompt
Update test-design-structure.sh harness pins to match the new approval-gates and SKILL prose
commit_message:
Remove redundant Gate B passive-summary AskUserQuestion

When plan-review-loop ends converged or cap-hit with manual_gate_b=false, Gate B now prints the multi-round summary and auto-continues to Step 3.6 without blocking on a Continue/Switch prompt. Gate C remains the single decision point; Discuss further covers the old switch-to-discussion intent. Harness pins updated accordingly.
